name: global-link-platform
description: AI email operations platform (multi-tenant refonte). See docs/architecture/refonte-plan.md.

scripts.build: npm run build:packages && npm run build -w apps/api --if-present && npm run build -w apps/worker --if-present && npm run build -w apps/web --if-present
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared && npm run build -w packages/db && npm run build -w packages/queue && npm run build -w packages/email && npm run build -w packages/ai && npm run build -w packages/core && npm run build -w packages/auth
